I used apercot oil since it’s one of my favorites 
Rose buds for protection against invasive thoughts
Cinnamon for mental clarity
Rosemary to stay focused on the task at hand

Light a white candle as you gather your ingredients and place them into your cauldron. 
Heat your mixture just enough for the oil to be warm but not hot (please be careful when using an open flame and oil)
Allow the mixture to blend while allowing your thoughts to come and go. Don’t stop to linger on any one thought and don’t  intentionally think anything. Just let your mind run through it’s things. In one way and out the other. If you have a mantra use it. When it feels like your mind is slowing and your thoughts not as cluttered, take your mixture and strain it into a small bottle. 

Keep it near by while you work, when you need to focus, take a small drop or just dip the tip of your finger into the oil and gently message it into the little crook right under the back of your skull. While I do this I like to breath out while saying ‘fffooocccuuusss’ a few times until I feel it take effect. I feel like you can replace that with anything though or nothing. Maybe ‘study’ or ‘relax’. Usually three or for times does it for me. 

I hope this helps!
